policy.generated_header_pattern: (?im)^\s*(?://|#|/\*|\*|<!--)\s*(?:code generated[^\n]*do not edit|this file (?:is|was) generated by|(?:this file (?:is|was) )?(?:<?auto[- ]?generated|automatically generated)|@generated)\b
notes: Only regular files tracked by the exact source commit are eligible; symlinks and submodules are not followed.
Programming, template and style languages in the explicit allowlist count toward SLOC; documentation, data and configuration languages do not.
Test, example and benchmark source files are included unless another explicit exclusion applies.

Vendored/generated exclusions use path rules, Git attributes, an anchored generated-file header and cloc --no-autogen. These are heuristic rules, not a claim that every generated file is identifiable.
SLOC is cloc physical code lines excluding blank and comment lines. Each tracked path counts separately, even when contents are identical.
